The steak is salted a day ahead and left uncovered in the fridge, then brought
up to temperature in a low oven before searing. Cooking it through first means
the sear only has to build a crust.

## Ingredients

- 1 steak
- Kosher salt
- Avocado oil or another high-smoke-point oil
- Flaky salt, to finish

## Method

1. Salt the steak heavily on all sides. Set it on a wire rack over a tray and
   refrigerate, uncovered, for 12–24 hr.
2. Preheat the oven to 290 °F.
3. Put the steak, still on the rack, in the oven. Cook until the centre reads
   130 °F, about 30 min.
4. Take the steak out. Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat until very hot.
5. Add a thin layer of oil. Sear the steak on both sides until well crusted.
6. Rest the steak, then slice it and sprinkle with flaky salt.
